name: Wyvern Warrior - for CWC Game Jam
author: PolygonPros
description:
Play the latest WebGL version here on Unity Play: https://play.unity.com/mg/other/wyvern-warrior-create-with-code-game-jam                                                      Download and Play the update version on itch.io!   https://polygonpros.itch.io/totally-not-dragon-warrior/download/CzZR3zrx41DeBt3J3oxYy_jcd3zA8TbDylabYNrw                                                For my CWC Game Jam entry, I chose to modernize the battle systems found in classic JRPGs like Dragon Warrior and Final Fantasy. The player faces off in combat against a dangerous dragon! Use your melee and magical attacks to whittle down your foe to 0 health points and win the day! 
I didn't get as far with this project as I wanted to, there's still lots more features and polish I planned to add. But for my very first game jam game, it was a fun start! I'm going to keep working on this game to get it closer to my original vision.
